# Chronicle verification

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:chronicle`. Edit the stories in
     `src/data/series/<series>/records/*.chronicle.ts` and the sources in
     `scripts/chronicle-sources.mjs` (One Piece),
     `scripts/chronicle-sources-hxh.mjs` (Hunter x Hunter) or
     `scripts/chronicle-sources-got.mjs` (Game of Thrones), then regenerate. -->

Every story in a character's chronicle (`chronicle` in the dossiers, filed in
`src/data/series/<series>/records/<saga>.chronicle.ts`) was checked against the
series' English wiki (onepiece.fandom.com, hunterxhunter.fandom.com, and for
Game of Thrones gameofthrones.fandom.com for the show and iceandfire.fandom.com
for the books) twice: once as it was written and once more by an independent
pass that re-read every episode against the episode page named in the table,
whose summary settles whether the event is complete by the end of that episode,
and against the character's wiki page (One Piece's `/History` cites each event
as `{{Qref|…|ep=N}}`). Where the second pass disagreed with the first, the story
was moved or rewritten; the note says what changed.

A note says in its own words what the wiki, the manga or the subtitles show. It
quotes a source only where the exact words prove a name or a threshold, at most
twice and briefly; the review behind that rule is in
[chronicle-quotation-review.md](chronicle-quotation-review.md).

The first batch — the twelve chronicles of the crew, Shanks and Ace — was
written on 2026-09-15 and re-verified on 2026-09-19. The Dressrosa batch —
Kaido's chronicle, and the Punk Hazard and Dressrosa stories the twelve were
missing — was written and re-verified on 2026-09-20. The Summit War batch —
Law's, Rayleigh's, Borsalino's, Sakazuki's and Sabo's chronicles, and the Summit
War stories the twelve were missing — was written and re-verified on 2026-09-20.
The Thriller Bark batch — Gecko Moria's chronicle, and the Thriller Bark stories
the twelve were missing — was written and re-verified on 2026-09-20. Hunter x
Hunter's batch — every Hunter Exam character, filed by #762 — was written and
re-verified on 2026-10-26. Game of Thrones' first batch, the Essos cast of the
first season and _A Game of Thrones_ (#1360), was written and re-verified by
three independent passes on 2026-11-17. A Game of Thrones story is dated by an
episode and a site chapter: one both media tell holds at both, and one told by a
single medium (`source`) at that medium's number alone, the other only ordering
it.

The rule is the one the `status` field already follows: **the episode filed is
the first one at whose end the viewer knows everything the story says**, with or
without a line saying it. Where a scene and its confirmation fall in different
episodes, the later one is filed. A too-early episode shows a story to a reader
who has not reached it, which is the one thing the site exists to prevent; a
too-late one only keeps it covered a little longer, and a few are filed late on
purpose, as the notes say.

Two further rules hold for every story, and the data tests
(`src/data/archive.test.ts`, "the chronicles") enforce what can be enforced:

- the first story sits at the character's own `revealedAtEpisode`, so the band
  never appears because something has happened;
- a story names only characters filed no later than its own episode, linked with
  a `[[id]]` marker or in plain words.

`scripts/chronicle-verification.test.mjs` holds the last rule this file can be
held to: every story below has a row, and every row below has a story.

Retitled: the beam was kicked apart, not the kick deflected. Chapter (#169): 1107, the last event: Sanji kicks the beam apart, says love beats light; Kizaru vows to take their heads (Chapter_1107 has the kick by the power of love and Kizaru’s vow to bring back their heads (Sanji Qref chap=1107 ep=1141)). |

Episode_1118 charDebut and character list: Nefertari Lili (silhouette); she is on screen only as a silhouette during Cobra's account, which counts as on screen (the Hiyori precedent in wano.ts). CR 1118: of the 20 monarchs who founded the World Government 800 years ago, moved their families to Mary Geoise and became the Celestial Dragons, Queen Lily of the Nefeltari Family kept her name among the First Twenty but did not become a Celestial Dragon and went back to Alabasta, so only 19 weapons surround the empty throne; yet her name is missing from the literature after the Void Century, she never made it back to Alabasta, and her younger brother ruled; the Elders say they too thought she went home and have no idea. At the end Imu speaks her name (JP speaker label イム, the name リリィ). JP names her as queen of the ネフェルタリ house, リリィ. No D. in her name in this episode. Chapter_1084: Queen Nefertari Lili (flashback), and Imu says Lili's name. Chapter (#169): the last event is chapter 1084, at or below the record’s own chapter 1084, so no pin. |
